headline: Global Central Banks Pause Rate Adjustments in October Following September Hikes
summary: Global central banks hit pause on monetary policy adjustments in October after implementing a wave of rate hikes in September.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions dictate global borrowing costs, currency valuations, and fixed-income yields, making policy pauses significant for asset allocation.

impacts.name: Global policy rates
impacts.why: A pause in rate adjustments halts the cycle of changing borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A coordinated halt in monetary tightening alters yield expectations across global fixed-income markets.
